points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable e49016d clean build succeeded in network-disabled cfd-bench with 2 CPUs/3 GiB/256 pids and documented external roots.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: io/restart.cpp loads state/time/step, but solver_driver.cpp:487–494 restores identical histories and immediately applies BDF2 on resume, limiting transient continuation.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Distinct mesh, partition, physics, solver, MPI and I/O modules; numerical drivers are separated from output.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No copied CFD core identified in inspected source; no exhaustive external authorship search was performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case inputs supply mesh/physics paths; no two-filename-only dispatch identified in inspected source.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: partition/distributed_mesh.cpp:282–286 constructs global mesh only within root setup scope; METIS and mpi/halo_exchange.cpp neighbor exchange are present.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Invalid input and nonfinite checks exist; residual-only plateau status accepts a false success and transient restart does not restore prior history.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean build passed; CTest reports no registered tests. Standalone test sources exist under solver/tools but were not independently executed.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Contestant checkpoint 1185ccd contains no tracked solver/build paths; 77 result files are preserved in the checkpoint and omitted from curated tip. Manager curation is not contestant misconduct.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: physics/flux.cpp and solver residual implement 2-D compressible inviscid and Newtonian/Fourier terms; report equations are present.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: cgns_reader.cpp:70–93,190–219,224–272 handles first-base multizone TRI/QUAD/BAR with one-to-one interface welding; unsupported element sections throw.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver/residual.cpp assembles finite-volume face fluxes and boundary conditions; actual cases exhibit unstable force and poor convergence.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: physics/flux.cpp implements Roe and Rusanov paths with entropy/shock handling. Production physics limits are evaluated separately.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver/residual.cpp:171–177,199–215 uses no-slip boundary state with zero output velocity; wall traction force split has its own deduction.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver/reconstruction.cpp builds primitive gradients and exchanges reconstructed fields through neighbor halo at :93–94.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver/reconstruction.cpp:51–59 selects Venkat or Barth limiter with reconstruction handling; poor case results do not prove the limiter was disabled.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver/residual.cpp:192–203 integrates full wall traction in viscous force while projecting tangentially only for Cf; report claims tangential-only. Corrected wall gradients and viscous flux exist.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver_driver.cpp:425–469 uses a residual-only bounded-range plateau heuristic; M015/M200 force windows demonstrate cases can be incorrectly labelled periodic.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: time_integrator.cpp:291–331 forms total spatial+BDF inner residual; selected run is failed at t0.74 with 74/74 misses. Metadata typical inner count is midpoint of observed extrema, not actual mean.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: partition/distributed_mesh.cpp root-local global mesh and metis_partition.cpp:58 provide partitioning; mpi/halo_exchange.cpp uses neighbor messages. Numerical rank-comparison review remains partial.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Six NACA packages pass examiner structural checks, but Re20 and Re200 fail the final-status requirement; M015 and M200 laminar success labels are false despite structural passes.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Read-only examiner invocation on 2026-10-30 passed six NACA packages and report, and rejected both cylinder packages for failed final convergence_status.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M015 inviscid and M200 laminar have falsely periodic success despite continuing force drift; Re20 and Re200 explicitly fail. These are separate facts.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M015 inviscid drag crosses negative while drifting; laminar cases have large forces or unsettled long windows; Re20 and Re200 fail. Individual force windows and limits are documented.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: All 19 accepted PDF pages are readable but contain no case plots; checkpoint includes 69 standalone PNGs with force, residual and field evidence. Figure/data traceability beyond checked cases remains under review.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report explicitly discloses failed cylinders but claims periodic success for drifting steady cases and tangential-only viscous drag although source integrates full traction.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Checkpoint 1185ccd preserves selected CSVs, standalone figures and manifest, while final curated tip omits figure/data blobs. Exact source binary revision is null and full figure-data correspondence remains partial.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable e49016d clean build passed in restricted network-disabled cfd-bench with documented external roots. io/restart.cpp stores state/time/step, but solver_driver.cpp:487–494 restores duplicated BDF histories and immediately uses BDF2 for a resumed step; uninterrupted transient restart is not preserved.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: cgns_reader.cpp:70–93,190–219,224–272 handles separate TRI/QUAD/BAR elements and welds multi-zone one-to-one interfaces; first-base and unsupported-section restrictions remain.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: solver/residual.cpp constructs conservative face fluxes and wall/farfield paths; no-slip output sets wall velocity to zero at :171–177, while the viscous force split is separately deficient.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: solver/reconstruction.cpp builds primitive gradients and Barth/Venkat limiter factors, exchanging reconstruction at :93–94; positivity/face fallback exists. Production accuracy is limited by actual poor case results.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: solver/residual.cpp:192–203 integrates full viscous traction into force accumulator while only surface Cf is projected tangentially, contrary to report.tex:472–477 claim. Corrected wall gradients and Newtonian/Fourier flux exist.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: time_integrator.cpp:291–331 forms spatial+BDF residual for each inner ratio, but selected Re200 failed at step74 with 74/74 target misses. solver_driver.cpp:689 sets typical iterations to midpoint(min,max), not actual mean; M200 lam raw mean25.543 vs metadata20.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: partition/distributed_mesh.cpp builds the full mesh on root in a local setup scope, metis_partition.cpp:58 invokes METIS, and mpi/halo_exchange.cpp uses neighbor exchanges; result rank comparisons remain limited.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: M015 inviscid and M200 laminar successful status contradicted by continuing force drift; other NACA cases have material convergence/force limits, Re20 failed and Re200 stopped at t0.74. Case-specific windows and delivered figures are documented.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Accepted 19-page text report and 69 standalone contestant figures exist, but report marks drifting steady cases statistically periodic and claims a tangential-only split while source integrates full traction; main PDF has no case plots and curated tip excludes figures.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separate mesh, partition, physics, solver, MPI and I/O modules; state and geometry are 2-D-specific.

flags.flag: metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful final results
flags.evidence: Checkpoint 1185ccd selected naca0012_m015_inviscid metadata SHA256 038c0dcd8f1902255e3a411d77a58a2f328e1ae7aa63f6079ecf58270d0b69b3 says completed=true, statistically_periodic. Its checkpoint-matched forces.csv SHA256 8613113c292b69c738b5b35d8a9f5df4c6ead7dd067b9a6f0df49049d76ab511 shows Cd descending from +0.510818 at step12001 to −0.054502 at step20000, including −0.026512→−0.054502 in final400; Cl −0.03513→−0.016532 over final4000. Delivered force plot visibly confirms continued drift rather than a stationary or periodic state. Immutable report.tex:21,875 and run_manifest.md:23,32–35 characterize steady cases as converged/statistically periodic. Re20 and Re200 status=failed are separately disclosed and are not charged merely for failure. No CFD rerun. M200 laminar is separately labelled statistically_periodic/completed despite a claimed stable plateau at step8000/50000; Cd changes 0.103284→0.122727 in its last4000 steps and 0.125419→0.122727 in the last1000, inconsistent with a stable long-window plateau.

Source implements implicit and BDF2 loops; explicit-only integration not established.
Claimed force split is produced through full-traction rather than tangential-only integration and is separately penalized; the underlying force algorithm exists, so absence is not inferred.
Checkpoint figure manifest and examined force endpoints support delivered plots; no specific unrelated-data figure proven.
Root-only full-mesh setup, METIS and neighbor halos exist; all-rank full-state/geometric-only shortcut not established.
Final source reconstructs both sides using limiter paths; bad numerical cases alone do not prove disabled production reconstruction.
solver/residual.cpp:171–177,199–215 outputs imposed zero no-slip wall velocity; undocumented adjacent-cell wall check failure not established.

limitations: No evaluator rerun was performed; cylinder Re200 was never rerun.
Structural validation is separate from substantive numerical scoring.
Raw solver artifacts remain workspace evidence and were excluded from the curated submission tip.
run_identity.json and contestant_final_response.md are unindexed sidecars.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
All ten sections, eight cases, 27 review points and 13 DQ rules assessed to available evidence. Historical producing binary and remaining figure attribution remain qualified; no CFD/Re200 rerun.
